name: Echoes of the Heart Loom
author: Fourfold Community
description: A compact expansion bundle with a new echo-realm, a rare companion, a story quest and a relic weapon. A glimpse of how full community expansions can combine content types.

dimensions.name: Echoing Crucible
dimensions.description: A realm of resonant stone, suspended ruins and pulsing sound-waves.

weapons.name: Heartspun Maul
weapons.description: A relic hammer woven from the Loom's old harmonics.

quests.name: Echoes Unanswered
quests.description: Gather 4 Lumen Shards to stabilise the echoing path.

lore.title: A Note Between Worlds
lore.text: When the Loom broke, not every fragment fell. Some became places. Others became living things.
